description: Open-Motion sensor secure bootloader (X-CUBE-SBSFU 2.8.0 port for STM32H743VI): ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 secure boot, USB DFU update with pre-erase header check, anti-rollback floor, RDP level 1 protections.

components.name: STM32 Secure Engine

components.name: X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB (STM32 Cryptographic Library, binary)
